! =============================================================================
! 3D Detail Level
! =============================================================================

if bEnable3DFunction then

	dim stDetail3D[8]
		stDetail3D[1] = `Scale Sensitive`
		stDetail3D[2] = `Full`
		stDetail3D[3] = `Simplified`
		stDetail3D[4] = `Off`
		stDetail3D[5] = `Chinese Simple`
		stDetail3D[6] = `Chinese Detailed`
		stDetail3D[7] = `Schematic`
		stDetail3D[8] = `by MVO`

	if (iFlagEnable3DSymbols = 0) then
  	  values{2} "iDWDet3D" 	DETLEVEL_DW3D_DETAILED,		stDetail3D[2],	! Full
							    DETLEVEL_DW3D_SIMPLE,	stDetail3D[3],	! Simplified
								DETLEVEL_DW3D_DRAFT,	stDetail3D[7],	! Schematic
							    DETLEVEL_DW3D_OFF,		stDetail3D[4]	! Off
	else

		dim sEnabled3DValues[]
		dim iEnabled3DValues[]

		i=1
		if bittest( iFlagEnable3DSymbols, 7) then                                              ! by MVO in Value list, 128
					sEnabled3DValues[i] = stDetail3D[8]
					iEnabled3DValues[i] = DETLEVEL_DW3D_MVO
					i = i + 1
		endif
		if bittest( iFlagEnable3DSymbols, 0) then                                              ! Scale Sensitive in Value list, 1
					sEnabled3DValues[i] = stDetail3D[1]
					iEnabled3DValues[i] = DETLEVEL_DW3D_SCALESENS
					i = i + 1
		endif
		if bittest( iFlagEnable3DSymbols, 1) then                                              ! Detailed in Value list,2
					sEnabled3DValues[i] = stDetail3D[2]
					iEnabled3DValues[i] = DETLEVEL_DW3D_DETAILED
					i = i + 1
		endif
		if bittest( iFlagEnable3DSymbols, 2) then                                              ! Simple in Value list,4
					sEnabled3DValues[i] = stDetail3D[3]
					iEnabled3DValues[i] = DETLEVEL_DW3D_SIMPLE
					i = i + 1
		endif
		if bittest( iFlagEnable3DSymbols, 6) then                                              ! Draft in Value list,64
					sEnabled3DValues[i] = stDetail3D[7]
					iEnabled3DValues[i] = DETLEVEL_DW3D_DRAFT
					i = i + 1
		endif
		if bittest( iFlagEnable3DSymbols, 3) then                                              ! Off in Value list,8
					sEnabled3DValues[i] = stDetail3D[4]
					iEnabled3DValues[i] = DETLEVEL_DW3D_OFF
					i = i + 1
		endif
		if bittest( iFlagEnable3DSymbols, 4) then                                              ! Chinese Simple in Value list,16
					sEnabled3DValues[i] = stDetail3D[5]
					iEnabled3DValues[i] = DETLEVEL_DW3D_CHI_SIMPLE
					i = i + 1
		endif
		if bittest( iFlagEnable3DSymbols, 5) then                                              ! Chinese Detailed in Value list,32
					sEnabled3DValues[i] = stDetail3D[6]
					iEnabled3DValues[i] = DETLEVEL_DW3D_CHI_DETAILED
					i = i + 1
		endif

		values{2} "iDWDet3D" iEnabled3DValues, sEnabled3DValues
	endif
endif
